protocol.failing_method: dropped from the served path (Gate D); recorded here as failed
protocol.pass_rule: for every k in the grid the 2.5th percentile of the cluster bootstrap of (deletion drop of the method - deletion drop of random) is above 0
protocol.residues_removed: ceil(k/100 * length), never all of them
protocol.rows: localization-labelled accessions of registry partitions 1-4 (stride 1), one row per distinct sequence; cluster = the registry cluster_code
protocol.scope: subset (500), not comparable to DeepLoc or to the Phase 8 full-corpus numbers

signal_peptide.mask: residues 1..cleavage within the CRF length cap
signal_peptide.metric: pooled-residue AUROC with the same cluster bootstrap
signal_peptide.rows: annotated signal-peptide accessions of partitions 1-4, usable cleavage site

protocol.target: the head's own top class: argmax of the raw sigmoid over all of its classes
